title: Meta plans to expand ads on Threads to all users globally starting next week; Threads began testing ads in the US and Japan a year ago (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: Meta plans to expand ads on Threads to all users globally starting next week; Threads began testing ads in the US and Japan a year ago — Meta on Wednesday announced it's expanding ads on Threads to all users globally. The expansion, which starts next week, will be gradual …
